speaker: Fade Wanderer
text: You've crossed into The Fade. This place is where all three worlds bleed together.

speaker: Fade Wanderer
text: I was a traveler once, like you. Then the rift swallowed my world. Now I exist between.

speaker: Fade Wanderer
text: Chancellor Draven did this. He opened the rift to seize power, and now reality itself is coming apart.

speaker: Fade Wanderer
text: He retreated to the Final Sanctum, beyond the Temporal Nexus. But the path is treacherous — fragments of time itself block the way.

speaker: Fade Wanderer
text: Defeat Draven, and the rift may close. But you'll need allies — strong ones. The Architect may be able to help.

speaker: Temporal Scholar
text: Time moves strangely here. I've seen the same moment repeat a hundred times.

speaker: Temporal Scholar
text: The Temporal Echoes are fragments of people who once existed. They mimic what they remember.

speaker: Temporal Scholar
text: Be careful — some of them remember how to fight very well.

speaker: The Architect
text: I built the Nexus to connect worlds peacefully. Draven corrupted my work to tear them apart.

speaker: The Architect
text: I cannot undo what he's done alone. But together, we might weave reality back together.

speaker: The Architect
text: Very well. My knowledge of the rift's structure will be invaluable. Let us end this.

speaker: The Architect
text: I can construct and deconstruct matter at will. I can weave the fabric of reality itself. Is that enough?

speaker: Kael
text: Lira! I've crossed three worlds to find you. I'm not leaving without you.

speaker: Lira
text: The Fade changed me, Dad. I can feel the rift — I can heal it. Let me help.
